The symbolic reference to the dawn or morning evokes feelings of hope and renewal.

In Islamic tradition, the dawn is a time of contemplation and reflection, a time when one can renew their faith and commit themselves to the path of righteousness. The mountain reference in the name can be seen as a symbol of the undying connection between the human spirit and the Creator, as mountains are often seen as sacred or divine in many cultures and religions. Overall, the name Fujairah serves as a powerful reminder of the beautiful interplay between culture, history, and the spiritual journey of the human soul.
